# Import identity fixture

`import-identity.jpg` is the byte-identical upstream v1.5.21 `docs/images/gallery/skin-01.jpg` fixture used by both platform import-identity tests. Its bytes form part of the fixed semantic fingerprint test vector. It is retained here so the tests do not depend on omitted marketing/gallery folders.

This fixture is test input only; the installer does not package `windows/tests/`.
